notes.title: Stellar Settlers: Full Release is Here! 🎉

[*] [b]All Game Modes Unlocked[/b] – Experience the challenge of Classic Mode, the relaxed pace of Chill Mode, the creative freedom of Sandbox Mode, the high-stakes tension of Spaceship Building Mode, the absolute chaos of Mayhem Mode, and the strategic intensity of Base Defense Mode!

notes.title: Combat Update - Early Access 0.9.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Settlers!

Combat Update is here. This update adds a new planets (asteroid) where you face enemy drones as negative event. Every 5 mins, a group of stronger alien drones will try to damage your base, you will need to build turrets to destroy them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/20034deb5c027e7d73d49fbe5e2c43cc096177c0.png[/img]

This update also adds a new game mode, "Base defense mode" where you can also play any planet you unlocked previously as a tower defense game, where the negative events turn into the attackers trying to destroy your colony.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/6cbf56cddf685cb63eabf79fd8216f652cd28954.png[/img]

You have 3 type of turrets that perform differently;

[b]Defense Tower[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Purpose:[/b] General-purpose tower designed to handle groups of smaller enemies effectively.
[*][b]Attack:[/b] Rapid fire with medium range and damage.
[*][b]Special Ability:[/b] Can prioritize targets based on proximity, focusing on clearing close threats quickly.
[*][b]Best Use:[/b] Ideal for crowd control and protecting key areas against swarms of enemies.
[/list]
[b]Sniper Tower[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Purpose:[/b] Long-range tower specialized in eliminating high-priority single targets.
[*][b]Attack:[/b] Slow rate of fire with very high damage and extreme range.
[*][b]Special Ability:[/b] Critical shots that deal extra damage to enemies with high health.
[*][b]Best Use:[/b] Perfect for taking down armored units, bosses, or enemies at a distance before they get too close.
[/list]
[b]Missile Tower[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Purpose:[/b] Area-of-effect (AoE) tower capable of dealing damage to clusters of enemies.
[*][b]Attack:[/b] Fires missiles that explode on impact, dealing splash damage over a large radius.
[*][b]Special Ability:[/b] Can be upgraded to track fast-moving targets or deliver cluster missiles for larger explosions.
[*][b]Best Use:[/b] Effective against groups of enemies or units that tend to bunch together, providing powerful area denial.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/1a99df7beaefa1fdba81c23cf53057c8e479efa1.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Enhancement: While placing a pod, now you will be able to see the connections with an arrow indicator to better decide the position of the pods that you are unfamiliar with.
[*] Enhancement: In the later stages of game, destroying expensive pods release way too many resources around, which lowers the FPS for some low end devices, resource container are now object pooled.
[*] Bug Fix: Disable auto scroll if no gamepad connected
[*] Bug Fix: delay on show spaceship part trigger first click
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/6ad4512b48d83e8b1a32fb93ed7aa4c9ac3a1bb5.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support during the Early Access.

---

If you enjoyed Stellar Settlers, please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2628570/Stellar_Settlers_Space_Base_Builder/]writing us a review on Steam[/url], as this helps us immensely in reaching new players, share your thoughts and ideas, we value your reviews a lot, and shape the game depending on it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2628570/Stellar_Settlers_Space_Base_Builder/

notes.title: Uncharted Update - Early Access 0.8.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Settlers!

Uncharted Update is here. This update adds 2 new planets that require you to change your playstyle to their unique challenges. Adapt to the environment, build a space colony, and engineer even crazier spaceships to escape from the planets.

[h2]New Planets[/h2]

Let's have a look at 2 new planets unlocked in this update.

[b]Planet HL-54-E: [/b] A planet made of constantly moving Rocks in a dense cloud.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/3e8078aeb86023017974a1ebaf74feace474b647.png[/img]

These towering rock platforms are in constant motion, rising and falling unpredictably. Building here requires precision and timing.

Here are some tips; 
- Construct with caution; moving platforms may disrupt your foundations. 
- Plan for vertical connections, as platforms won't always align. 
- Timing your launch is crucial—ensure stable ground before takeoff.

This is a challenging terrain with ever-changing elevations. Let’s make these peaks our new home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/c8a6472760a4b2927fd552590662c32005f8debc.jpg[/img]

[b]Planet TX-11-B: [/b] A planet taken by an evergrowing single tree organism.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/c7ef889acab83026dd3bbdc470ab276814941451.png[/img]

This strange, mist-covered planet is dotted with mysterious trees and peculiar growth patterns. The terrain is treacherous, and building space is sparse.

Here are some tips; 
- Utilize the limited and scattered area wisely, and consider modular expansions to optimize space. 
- Keep an eye on your thrusters; high gravity value of this planet and the mist may interfere with launch sequences.

Prepare yourself for a test of strategic placement and resource management.

notes.title: Game Modes Update - Early Access 0.7.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Settlers!

Game Modes are here! Morph the gameplay depending on your preferences. Do you want an extra chill experience with no negative events? Or do you want to build crazy spaceship builds and launch them? Unlimited resources? 

Or do you like more challenges, such as negative events every minute? We don't judge you :)


[h2]Game Modes[/h2]

Let's have a look at what modes we have for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/78e3492203f40bd34e9a8fb08829382ffa243896.png[/img]

[b]Classic Mode[/b]: Comes unlocked
Classic Stellar Settlers experience, balance between resource management, exploration, and survival.

[b]Chill Mode[/b]: Unlocks at level 3
No events, full settler morale, laidback cozy game, perfect for players who want a stress-free environment and focus on building and relaxing.

[b]Sandbox Mode[/b]: Unlocks at level 7
Unlimited resources, no rules, cool space base designs, ideal for creative players who want to experiment and create without limitations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/62db15f932665bdb928856577b8f0932dd88a54f.png[/img]

[b]Spaceship Mode[/b]: Unlocks at level 10
Build and try to launch spaceships with a given budget, and challenge your engineering skills and resource management to successfully reach the stars.

[b]Mayhem Mode[/b]: Unlocks at level 15
Constant negative events every minute, for hardcore players, test your survival skills and strategic thinking under relentless pressure.

[b]Base Defense Mode[/b]: Unlocks at level 20 (unavailable for now)
Protect your base against a constant horde of aliens, combine tactical defense strategies and resource allocation to withstand the onslaught. This mode will be available after the "combat update".

For Example, let's look into Spaceship Building Mode;

It is just what is says it is. You have a set budget where you build a spaceship and try to do a successful launch. Go absurd for fun, or engineer an efficient one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/f790453abb4f142f9607a5b853f08df951980bb5.png[/img]

Do you think this one is going to launch successfuly?

We hope you enjoy the new in-game content.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2628570/Stellar_Settlers_Space_Base_Builder/

notes.title: QoL & Scalability Update - Early Access 0.6.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Settlers!

My team took a nice rest, and we have been at work for the last month for our first Early Access update of "QoL & Scalability" Update. Which we aim to fix quality life life issues in game and improve the game performance for scalable and stable base builds. 

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
We made a lot of small changes in this update to a lot of things, so instead of giving you a patch notes this time, I prepared a highlight section to talk about different updates.

[h2][b]Performance:[/b] [/h2]With the performance upgrades we did, I'm very happy with the current state of the game, your base can be anything you imagine, and there is no technical barrier to stop you. No limits, the limit is your imagination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/895ce1c130db25115df5d467a23be83a0bb5683b.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Quality Of Life:[/b] [/h2]We appreciate you giving all the feedback about the usability of the UI and sticking with us. We have some nice features now like, search input in the research screen, filtering available pods in the bottom view, press space to stop the game, and more extended game controller support. This was mostly requested and we decided to bundle this into the QoL update. Now every planet has its special quests, these quests are different on every planet. We believed on focusing on increasing the quality of the current content in the game instead of new content. And as promised new content is on the way.

Additionally, we added 20 new settlers from different tiers to make gameplay more replayable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/66b7d80ada0aa7a45d5f4af300653923e4246aa1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/2b8ff4fac61bfdcc7197fd8536f8f570458638af.png[/img]

[h2][b]Better Steam Cloud Save:[/b] [/h2]There were issues with our implementation where sometimes the game doesn't sync the player's progress. We reworked this system to make it very future-proof. You can play the game across your devices with one save and uninstall the game anytime and reinstall again later, and still keep your full progress, your EXP, current planet run, settlers etc.

[h2][b]More Achievements:[/b] [/h2]Not we have 20 achievements on Steam, players were asking for this, we had time for 20 in this version, but there is some nice ones you can grind for :) We will add more achievements in every major update during our Early Access and try to get to 100 on the full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44700247/e1c0998ef3d3b7bb457551bf723695d700310ba1.png[/img]

We aim to release a new planet every month, with game modes and other updates in between. We will make sure you don't wait for them too long. Tho, for now, they are there to hopefully excite you.

notes.title: Stellar Settlers Early Access 0.5.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Settlers,

As my team is taking a deserved break till the start of April. I have been watching reactions and feedback from players, and wanted to focus on some persistent balance issues, handle some stability issues and keep you updated with some of our plans.

This update won't have any new content, as mentioned team is on a break after the release.

- My goal in balancing the game is to make sure there is none to small waiting time for resource. This is especially a problem for waiting resources on spaceship cost resources.
- To combat this I'm going to try almost halving the cost of all spaceship parts in game (including Launch pad cost 500->300 per resource)
- Following that, the gravity of planets will be slightly increased and the explosion & malfunction chances will be 21->25% by default.
- So this means, slightly harder launches, but half the cost. This would increase the feeling of engineering a "better spaceship design" all around the board.

[h3]Japanese Font Enhancements[/h3]
There was an issue about displaying Kanji-characters in Japanese version of the game, which we fixed this.

[h3]Steam Trading Cards[/h3]
Steam, approved Stellar Settlers for profile capabilities and Steam Trading cards after just a week of release. Now you will drop cards, backgrounds and emojis while you play.

Additional Fixes;
- fix hub tunnel placement on top
- fix hauler air supply targeting on map with islands
- flood and rainstorm height control of structures

Thank you for playing, please keep the feedbacks coming!

notes.content:
Hey Settlers, AMD Graphics Card users in specific.

There was an issue with AMD Radeon 6XXX GPUs in specific that cause these cards to go hyperdrive more. To be clear this is a driver issue on AMD's end that they need to fix. In the latest build, we limit our resource using budget, and put an FPS Cap since these drivers try to give the game a crazy amount of FPS.

We confirmed with multiple players that this fix now works with no issues at acceptable GPU usage percentage.

Hope you enjoy, thank you for the patience.

notes.title: v0.5.57 - Release Day Hotfix & Balance Update, Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Settlers!

Thank you for the awesome response to the release! We have been reading and watching the reactions and feedback, we fixed few issues in game and did some balancing depending on the feedback we got from the playerbase!

- Fixed "Camera Zoom acting weird", there was an issue with new unity input system which we fixed.
- Balanced launchpad cost, the material cost was 1000 per, now 700 per material.
- Balanced 1st level passive generator pod costs to make the early game more normalized (increased a little bit)

This was soft locking the game. We would love to hear your feedback about these.

Thank you for being patient, and please give us a review on Steam to share your thoughts, we will read each of them!

notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]Today is a very important day for us! During Nextfest, we make the "Spaceship Building" part of our game available to play for the duration of the Nextfest, make sure to give it a try. This update is also on the playtest branch.
[/b]
There was a lot of bug fixing and polishing this week, and sorry for the late update, we wanted to polish the demo as much as we could before the NextFest. Oh also, we support 13 languages now, some of the Localization QA is done, but some of them are still work in progress!

[b]New Additions:[/b]
- Recycling Center, Robotics Lab, Silicon Factory, Cryogenic Pod, Green House, Defence System Bot, and Ship Wreck have been added to the game.
- Implemented various new structures including entertainment center, miner factory, and nano material assembler.
- Added spaceship effects, thruster effect starts on launch, and spaceship explosion and malfunction mechanics.
- New UI features such as a demo panel, spaceship design handbook UI, and an in-game debug screen.
- Localization improvements for multiple languages and UI adjustments to support these changes.

[b]Gameplay Updates:[/b]
- Enhanced localization for bot hovers, event indicators, settler assigning flow, and many other elements.
- Updated the bot localisation via SO and fixed various localisation errors.
- Adjusted button sizing for botinfo panel & structure info panel.
- Improved vertical tunnel placement and storage collider adjustments.
- Enhanced quest progression logic and fixed general quest progression issues.
- Implemented a default language picker depending on Steam language settings.
- Updated launch info panel to stay active and show percentages.
- Adjusted spaceship button functionalities and camera movements for better gameplay experience.
- Added and updated various gameplay elements like spaceship parts button, ore info panel translation, and entertainment center morale generation.

[b]Fixes:[/b]

- Fixed issues related to storage, research button hover text, layout shifts, and tutorial button functionality.
- Addressed bugs in structure placement, ghost notes, and spaceship part tooltips.
- Resolved issues with miner target rotation, hauler container null checks, and environment object navmesh.
- Fixed tunnel placement issues for downward tunnels and nano material assembler.
- Adjusted storage count from zero and fixed trade screen and text overflow issues.

- Performed sync of translations and various optimizations across the game.
- Implemented performance comments to enhance game efficiency.
- Disabled build navmesh and removed all structures from navmesh for performance improvement.

- Enhanced UI interactions with new scroll rect customizations and sensitivity adjustments.
- Implemented spaceship self-destruction mechanics and fixed related issues.
- Added and updated various animations for a richer game experience.

This update brings a host of improvements, fixes, and new features aimed at enhancing gameplay, expanding content, and refining the overall player experience.

Thank you everyone for your support and wishlists <3

- Implemented rocket part model prefabs for spaceship construction.

- Players must now wait 1 minute between events for balance.
- Added earthquake camera shake effect for realism.

- Notifications are now hidden when not needed.
- Demo timer duration changed to 1160 seconds for gameplay adjustments.

- The last 4 messages will now be displayed.

notes.content:

In this update;
[b]Game Patch Notes - Update November 16, 2023[/b]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]

[b]Structure Management Improvements:[/b]
- Introduced a new "structurelist" feature to enhance structure management.
- Implemented a system for saving Global IDs (GIDs) for structures.
- Enabled GID assignment during structure construction.
- Added the capability to identify structures using GIDs.

[b]Miner Unit Enhancements:[/b]
- Improved miner unit movement for smoother gameplay.
- Containers now exert force when colliding with miners, enhancing realism.
- Miners now function as obstacles while mining to prevent collisions.

[b]Sickbay and Container Interaction:[/b]
- Introduced rectangular selection functionality for sickbays.
- Containers no longer remain inside ore deposits, reducing interference.

[b]Vertical Tunnel Enhancements:[/b]
- Refined checks for vertical tunnel placement.
- Fixed issues with slot activation in vertical tunnels.
- Tunnel placement now requires a minimum Y coordinate of 9.

[b]Hauler Behavior:[/b]
- Containers now apply force when on top of structures.
- Create hauler button visibility now depends on factory connectivity.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[b]Miner Movement and Sickbay Research:[/b]
- Resolved inaccuracies in miner unit movement.
- Fixed premature research activation in sickbays.

[b]Tunnel Placement:[/b]
- Addressed issues related to tunnel placement constraints.

[b]Container Interaction:[/b]
- Rectified the problem of containers staying inside ores.
- Corrected the issue of containers failing to exert force when colliding with miners.

[b]Factory Connectivity:[/b]
- Concealed the create hauler button when the factory is not connected.

[h3]Performance Improvements:[/h3]

[b]Navmesh Optimization:[/b]
- Optimized the game's navmesh tests for improved performance.

[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]

[b]Resource Management:[/b]
- Implemented a quest saving system for better resource management.
- Adjusted constant ore spawning positions for gameplay balance.
- Fixed resource generation amounts for more accurate gameplay.
- No longer displaying "no connection" notifications when structures are adversely affected.
- HQ now generates 4 materials for better resource balance.

[h3]Visual Enhancements:[/h3]

[b]Material and UI Improvements:[/b]
- Enhanced collapsed and collapsed hover materials for improved visuals.
- Added new material spawn effects upon demolishing for a more immersive experience.
- Improved create unit buttons for enhanced user interface.
- Enhanced unit spawning and logistic factory user interface for better gameplay experience.
- Corrected the logistic factory collider for visual consistency.

[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]

[b]Error Handling and Fixes:[/b]
- Addressed various error checks and fixes for a more stable gameplay experience.

[h3]Technical Updates:[/h3]

[b]Save System Improvements:[/b]
- Removed the legacy save system for better data management.
- Restructured save structure data for improved efficiency.
- Implemented saving upon using the main menu button for player convenience.
- Added support for saving structure rotations for more accurate data retention.
- Structures' positions are now saved for better continuity.
- Implemented saving for Structure Type IDs for improved data tracking.
- Introduced support for structure GID (Global ID) saving to streamline data management.

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]

[b]Visual and Resource Issues:[/b]
- Some players may still encounter water black strip issues on the second planet.
- An issue with resource generation exceeding 150 has been reported.

Please note that this patch includes various bug fixes, improvements, and new features to enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
